title: Full-suite check at reviewing exit ignores a green capture of the same tree taken in the previous phase
detail: capture-reuse-across-phases (2026-11-20): the green full-suite capture (4539, --phase regression) ran in solo_execute at tree 77e737d43cbb9e24; reviewers reused it, so no run happened inside reviewing. _full_suite_gate (gate.py) counts reviewer_execution_verified/prove_run records only since the current phase was entered, so reviewing->integrating printed 'no green full-suite tests run ... recorded this reviewing phase' for a tree that was proven green. Same class as fb-d39ef32820e4, keyed on the ledger window: proof should be credited by tree hash, not by phase window.
